identity.name: Uncommon WPAD Query Execution via PowerShell
identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to execute a script that queries for WPAD (Web Proxy Auto-Discovery) settings, which is an uncommon behavior for typical Windows endpoints. Cortex should detect this deviat
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to execute a script that queries for WPAD (Web Proxy Auto-Discovery) settings, which is an uncommon behavior for typical Windows endpoints. Cortex should detect this deviation from normal network activity and process behavior. The attack involves downloading a malicious script, executing it, and querying WPAD settings.

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process executing the malicious script
Outbound connection to C2 server for downloading script

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon WPAD Query Process
biocs.description: Detection of a process performing an uncommon WPAD query
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'wpad'

abiocs.name: Uncommon WPAD Query Behavior
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation of PowerShell querying WPAD settings in an uncommon context
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 80
| filter dst_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'wpad'
abiocs.causality_anchor: powershell.exe initiating network connection to C2 server

xql_queries.name: Detect WPAD Query from PowerShell
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 80
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'wpad'
